title: Pass on the lesson time

scenario.en: The teacher tells you about tomorrow's lesson. Your friend was not there. He needs the time and the room.
scenario.ar: المدرّس قالك على درس بكرة. صاحبك مكانش موجود، ومحتاج المعاد ورقم الأوضة.

source: "The English lesson is at ten o'clock on Sunday. It is in room number twelve. It is one hour."

task.en: Tell your friend the time, the day, and the room number.
task.ar: قول لصاحبك المعاد واليوم ورقم الأوضة.

key_points.en: The lesson is at ten o'clock.
It is in room number twelve.

model_answer.en: The English lesson is at ten o'clock on Sunday, in room twelve. It is one hour.
model_answer.ar: درس الإنجليزي الساعة عشرة يوم الأحد، في أوضة اتناشر، ومدته ساعة.
